#8.3 Question 2.

```{r}
reverse_plot <- plotErrors(errR, nominalQ=TRUE)

print(reverse_plot)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = "reverse_error_plot.png",
  plot = reverse_plot, 
  width = 10, 
  height = 10, 
  dpi = 300
)

```

- We see the reverse reads have similar results as the forward reads.

#8.3.5 Question 3.

```{r}
old_file <- here::here("outputs/mouse_ASVs.fa")
new_file <- here::here("new_mouse_ASVs.fa")

if (file.exists(old_file)) {
  file.rename(from = old_file, to = new_file)
  cat("Successfully renamed file to")
} else {
  cat("Unsuccessful")
}

new_mouse <- readLines(here::here("new_mouse_ASVs.fa"))
indexed_read_ASV15 <- which(new_mouse == ">ASV15")

asv15 <- new_mouse[indexed_read_ASV15:(indexed_read_ASV15 + 4)]

indexed_read_ASV188 <- which(new_mouse == ">ASV188")

asv188 <- new_mouse[indexed_read_ASV188:(indexed_read_ASV188 + 4)]

```

- The two ASVs that were chosen were ASV15 and ASV188
